authorityBoundary: This record freezes current authoritative source/status facts used to classify the ten DPL-T7 substantive blockers. It does not perform planning determination, structural engineering, legal boundary determination, measured survey, flood modelling or evidence commissioning.

sources.title: Bromley Local Plan 2019 — Policy 8 Side Space
observed: The Bromley Local Plan was adopted in 2019 and remains part of the operative development plan.
Policy 8 normally requires a minimum 1 metre side space for a residential proposal of two or more storeys, retained for the full height and length of the building.
Where higher standards of separation already exist, Policy 8 expects more generous side space, so 1 metre is a numeric floor rather than a complete qualitative planning pass.
sources.authorityBoundary: Adopted planning policy. Exact compliance still requires authoritative site-boundary geometry and planning judgement for the higher-separation remainder.

sources.title: Review of the Bromley Local Plan / Direction of Travel
observed: The current official Bromley review surface records the 2025 Direction of Travel as the second Regulation 18 consultation.
The council explicitly states that the Direction of Travel does not contain draft policies.
The page describes preparation of a Submission Draft as a next step; it does not expose such a draft as adopted or operative development-plan policy.
sources.authorityBoundary: Current source/status fact only. It does not assign planning weight to any future or unpublished policy.

sources.title: Draft London Plan consultation
observed: The Mayor published a Draft London Plan for statutory consultation from 16 July to 15 October 2026.
The draft is not the adopted London Plan; examination is scheduled for 2027 and adoption for 2028.
sources.authorityBoundary: Emerging strategic-plan status only. Candidate-specific material weight remains planning judgement.

sources.title: National Planning Policy Framework — DM4 Emerging development plan proposals
observed: Relevant emerging-plan policies may be given weight according to stage of preparation, unresolved objections and compliance with the Framework.
The Framework does not supply one universal scalar material weight for a candidate site.
sources.authorityBoundary: National policy supplies the weighting factors; application of those factors to relevant emerging policies remains planning judgement.

sources.title: Building Regulations etc. (Amendment) (England) Regulations 2026 — regulation 5
observed: For non-HRB work, the 2026 amendments have a transition keyed to whether the relevant notice/application is given before 24 March 2027 and work is commenced before 24 March 2028.
The Lennard Reference House control has no admitted future building-control notice/application date or qualifying commencement event.
sources.authorityBoundary: The transition rule is authoritative, but exact future source applicability cannot be selected before the project events on which the rule turns exist.

sources.title: Check the long term flood risk for an area in England
observed: The Environment Agency service provides area-level long-term screening for rivers/sea, surface water, reservoirs and groundwater where data is available.
The service explicitly does not state whether an individual property will flood.
sources.authorityBoundary: Appropriate high-level SCREENING source, not a property-specific flood assessment, FRA, drainage design or proof of absence. Exact address-level output for the Lennard candidate has not yet been admitted into the control record.

classificationRules: A future project event is not missing site evidence merely because it has not happened yet.
A planning-weight judgement is not converted into a survey requirement.
The HMLR title-index polygon may expose a decision-critical geometry risk but cannot prove a legal or measured side-boundary clearance.
Where one narrow evidence item legitimately serves multiple blockers, T8 records a shared evidence class rather than duplicating procurement.
No evidence is commissioned by T8.
